items.headline: $BTW Rallies 84% While Bitcoin Tumbles 7%
items.summary: Bitway's $BTW surged nearly 84% against the market dump, with $6.49M in daily volume against a $1.35B valuation — though its 30-day loss isn't fully erased yet.

items.headline: $VVV Jumps 33% as Venice Revenue Tops $200M
items.summary: Venice Token $VVV gained 33% while BTC and $TAO fell, as founder Erik Voorhees revealed $200M+ annualized revenue and two new burn mechanisms.

items.headline: $HYPE Joins Franklin Templeton's Crypto Index ETF
items.summary: Franklin Templeton's EZPZ crypto index ETF will add Hyperliquid's $HYPE effective Dec. 1, per an SEC prospectus supplement — a big institutional nod for the perp DEX token.

items.headline: Fidelity Files for Spot $LINK ETF on Nasdaq
items.summary: Fidelity filed with the SEC for a spot Chainlink ETF holding $LINK directly (no staking), joining Grayscale and Bitwise in the race — filing, not launch.

items.headline: $COW Fees Double, Ethereum Drives 92% of Gain
items.summary: CoW Swap fees doubled month-over-month with Ethereum driving ~92% of the increase — four days alone generated nearly 39% of the month's fees.
